supraorbital_contour.structural_silhouette: strongly M-shaped with a distinct central depression
supraorbital_contour.lateral_prominence: Broad lateral extension exceeding the outer margins of the ocular canthi

macro_zonal_melanin_distribution.regional_intensity_contrast: High contrast between the lighter (lower intensity) muzzle and periocular zones against the darker (higher intensity) cranial and lateral hair

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct pale depigmentation rings surrounding the periocular regions
